question: _________ assumed the charge as Registrar General & Census Commissioner of India with effect from November 1, 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan** assumed the charge as Registrar General & Census Commissioner of India with effect from November 1, 2022.
 
• The Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India is responsible for conducting the decennial Census and other related activities.
 
• This position plays a crucial role in collecting and analyzing demographic data which is essential for planning and policy-making.
 
• Mritunjay Kumar Narayan's appointment is expected to bring in new insights and leadership to the Census operations in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years and is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world.
 
• It provides comprehensive data about the population, including age, sex, literacy, occupation, and other key demographic indicators.
 
• The data collected through the Census is crucial for effective governance, policy formulation, and implementation of various government schemes.
 
• The Census also helps in understanding the socio-economic conditions of the country and aids in resource allocation.
